item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: ONE GAMES
  • 発売日: 2016-03-25
  • スコア: 6.29/10 (25 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 世界一ヤリたい授業 ～林先生のロリビッチな反転世界～
  • 英語名: Sekai-Ichi Yaritai Jugyou Rin-sensei no Loli Bitch na Hanten Sekai

别名

  • Sekaiichi Yaritai Jyugyo The Class I Want To Do Most

あらすじ

Shuuji Hayashi was a rookie teacher that all the students hated.

One day three of them locked him in the equipment room.

That’s where he found the glasses.

They didn’t just give him a new view of the world.
